Departmental Division

The 4 Houses of NEXUS

The entire department is split into 4 formidable houses. Every win scores valuable points for your house leaderboard!

Wootz

Legendary crucible steel of ancient India, unbreakable strength and absolute dominance on the field.

Vajra

Indra's diamond thunderbolt — unmatched hardness, explosive energy, and lightning-fast tactical plays.

Ayas

The ancient Vedic word for metal — calculated precision, forged discipline, and flawless execution under pressure.

Astra

The celestial weapon — fierce resilience, sharp aggression, and unstoppable comeback momentum.

Scoring Mechanics

Dynamic Points Allocation Table

Points are allocated based on actual interest form responses — Gold for 1st place, Silver (70% of Gold) for 2nd, and Bronze (50% of Gold) for 3rd. Notice how Cricket leads with the highest number of responses and the biggest points pool! 🏏
